mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.persona_id AS personaId, u.activo, u.bloqueado, p.nombre AS personaNombre, p.primer_apellido AS personaPrimerApellido, p.email FROM usuario u LEFT JOIN persona p ON p.id = u.persona_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = FALSE
SELECT r.nombre FROM rol r INNER JOIN usuario_rol ur ON ur.rol_id = r.id WHERE ur.usuario_id = #{usuarioId} AND ur.deleted = FALSE AND r.deleted = FALSE AND r.activo = TRUE
